variants.title: CE amplifier with a BC547C transistor: gain and frequency response
variants.sample: BC547C n-p-n transistor (hFE group C, 420 to 800)
variants.unknown: the mid-band gain and half-power frequencies
variants.note: The same circuit with a higher-gain transistor: the bias hardly moves with beta, so the mid-band gain changes only a little. The lower limit of the group's hFE range is used.

source.title: ON Semiconductor BC546/BC547/BC548 datasheet, hFE classification (group C: 420-800 at I_C = 2 mA, V_CE = 5 V)

variants.title: Frequency response of a two-stage RC-coupled amplifier
variants.sample: Two identical BC547B stages, RC coupled
variants.unknown: the gain and bandwidth of two RC-coupled stages
variants.note: Two identical stages in cascade multiply the gain (about 80 dB here) and narrow the bandwidth, because each stage's corner contributes; the input is 0.2 mV for that reason.

source.title: Sedra and Smith, Microelectronic Circuits: cascaded common-emitter amplifiers and RC coupling
